interpretation: The MM-only values use the corrected LJSIGMA=1 QuanPol export.
This is a single-frame finite-shell diagnostic, not a free energy.
On this frame the QM/MM replacement changes the endpoint double difference by only about -0.225 kcal/mol.
The dominant finite-shell endpoint difference is therefore the MM/environment term, not the DFTB3 QM replacement.
This does not prove the QM correction is useless across frames; it establishes that multi-frame sampling is required before ranking claims.
